national_news.title: PM Addresses Centenary Celebrations of SRCC, Highlights Economic Progress
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the centenary celebrations of Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC) in New Delhi, highlighting India's position as the fastest-growing major economy with a 7.8% quarterly growth rate.

Key statistics cited include smartphone exports crossing ₹2.5 lakh crore, domestic defense production reaching nearly ₹2 lakh crore, and defense exports surging from ₹600-700 crore in 2013-14 to ₹40,000 crore.
Highlighted infrastructure development speed, noting that railway network electrification increased from under 30% in 2014 to nearly 100% within 12 years.

national_news.title: India to Host Inaugural iBRICS Summit Alongside 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi
bullets: Over 500 institutional investors, finance ministers, and business leaders will attend the inaugural iBRICS Summit in New Delhi, organized alongside the 18th BRICS Summit.

The summit aims to connect sovereign capital with infrastructure, energy, and digital projects, as well as discuss non-dollar settlements and interoperability between payment systems like India's UPI and Brazil's Pix.
India holds the BRICS Chairship for 2026 under the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.

national_news.title: IAF Sarang Helicopter Display Team Participates in Egypt's El Alamein Airshow
bullets: The Indian Air Force's Sarang Helicopter Display Team is participating in the second edition of the El Alamein International Airshow at El Alamein International Airport, Egypt.
Operating the indigenously designed Advanced Light Helicopter (ALH) Dhruv, the five-helicopter display team will debut a new manoeuvre called 'Spot Stall Turn' alongside its 'Dolphin Leap'.
Formed in 2002, the Sarang team represents IAF's international defense diplomacy and showcases indigenous aerospace capabilities.

national_news.title: 16th National Meet of State Biodiversity Boards Held in Chandigarh
bullets: The National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) organized the 16th National Meet of State Biodiversity Boards (SBBs) and UT Biodiversity Councils (UTBCs) in Chandigarh from September 6–7, 2026.

Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change Bhupender Yadav urged states and UTs to align local governance mechanisms with the Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023 and Biological Diversity Rules, 2024.

The meet highlighted the role of Biodiversity Management Committees (BMCs) and People's Biodiversity Registers (PBRs), alongside India's progress on international commitments including the 7th National Report to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD).

national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu Confers National Teachers Awards
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu conferred the National Teachers Awards on the occasion of Teachers' Day in New Delhi.
A total of 48 selected school teachers from 27 States, seven Union Territories, and six Central Government organizations received the awards.
The President also presented National Awards to 21 faculty members and teachers from Higher Education Institutions and polytechnics.

national_news.title: PM Modi Interacts with 82 National Teachers' Day Award Winners
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with 82 National Teachers' Award winners across school education, higher education, and skill development sectors.
He urged teachers to look beyond textbooks, emphasize experiential learning, and connect students with real-world practical skills under NEP guidance.
The PM raised concerns regarding excessive screen time among children and called for continuous awareness campaigns against drug abuse.

national_news.title: Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh Launches 'CSS Shield' Initiative
bullets: Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh launched the 'CSS Shield' initiative set up by the Central Secretariat Service (CSS) Forum in New Delhi.
The mechanism serves as a mutual financial support system aimed at providing a minimum assistance of Rs 15 lakh to the families of deceased CSS officers.
Since 2020, CSS officers have voluntarily contributed around Rs 1.30 crore to assist families of approximately 65 to 70 deceased colleagues.

bihar_news.title: Proposed 1,170 km Delhi-Patna High-Speed Rail to Cut Travel Time to 4.5 Hours
bullets: The proposed Delhi-Uttar Pradesh-Bihar High-Speed Rail Corridor spans 1,170 km, aiming to reduce travel time between Delhi and Patna from 12–15 hours to 4.5 hours.
Executing agency National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL) has proposed a design speed of 350 km/h and an operational speed of 320 km/h for the corridor.
The route is planned to cover major economic, cultural, and political hubs including Delhi, Agra, Kanpur, Lucknow, Prayagraj, Varanasi, and Patna.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Set Up 700 Model Schools for NEET-JEE and Establish Teacher Training University
bullets: Bihar announced the development of around 700 Saraswati Vidya Niketan Model Schools across the state to offer academic support and coaching facilities for NEET and JEE aspirants.
A dedicated Teacher Training University will be set up to provide structured, regular training to over 7 lakh teachers spanning primary, higher, engineering, and polytechnic education.
The state plans to build a modern artificial intelligence ecosystem in collaboration with leading technology firms, including Google, Microsoft, and Sarvam AI.

bihar_news.title: NMC Approves Two New Medical Colleges in Bihar with 100 MBBS Seats
bullets: The National Medical Commission (NMC) issued Letters of Permission (LoPs) for two new medical colleges in Bihar for the 2026-27 academic session.
The institutions approved are Government Medical College in Chhapra (Saran) and Ram Janki Medical College and Hospital in Samastipur, each starting with an annual intake of 50 MBBS seats.
The addition of 100 MBBS seats is designed to strengthen local medical education and boost specialized healthcare access across Samastipur and Saran districts.

bihar_news.title: India-Nepal Transboundary Cooperation Needed for Himalayan Flood Management
bullets: Highlights the transboundary nature of flood risks between Nepal, Bihar, and Uttar Pradesh due to the shared Himalayan river system, including the vulnerable Kosi river basin.
Advocates shifting from reactive engineering solutions like embankments to proactive joint risk management, including real-time monitoring and joint forecasting models.
Emphasizes institutional cooperation for sharing data on sediment loads, changing river channels, glacial lake outburst floods (GLOFs), and structural conditions of barrages to protect North Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Addressing Cross-Border Himalayan Floods and River Management between India and Nepal
bullets: Catastrophic floods in Nepal and their downstream impact on Bihar highlight the need for cooperative transboundary risk management rather than reactive engineering.
The 2008 Kosi catastrophe remains a key reminder of how institutional failures and embankment breaches compound natural disasters in Bihar.
Experts emphasize the necessity for joint forecasting models, real-time monitoring of catchments, and shared data on sediment movement and glacial lakes between India and Nepal.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Mandates Prior Consent for CBI Probes Against State Public Servants
bullets: The Home Department of Bihar issued a notification making state government consent mandatory for the CBI to investigate offences involving Bihar public servants and state-controlled entities.
The notification accords general consent for CBI investigations against Central Government employees, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), and central private entities in Bihar.
The CBI derives its powers from Section 6 of the Delhi Special Police Establishment (DSPE) Act, 1946, which requires state consent for exercising jurisdiction within state borders.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Mandates Pre-Approval for CBI Investigations Involving State Officials
bullets: The Bihar government has restricted general consent for the Central Bureau of Investigation, mandating case-by-case prior permission to probe state officials.
Issued under Section 6 of the Delhi Special Police Establishment Act, 1946, the notification ensures localized state oversight on investigative proposals.
Central Government employees, Central PSUs, and central agency-controlled individuals remain covered under general consent within the state.

bihar_news.title: RVNL Bags ₹903 Crore Infrastructure Order for Buxar Thermal Power Project
bullets: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) received a Letter of Award worth ₹903.01 crore from SJVN Thermal Private Limited for railway siding works in Bihar.
The contract involves constructing a permanent railway siding and aerial track connection to Chausa and Pawani Kamarpur under Phase-III of the 1,320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project (BTPP).
The domestic infrastructure project has an execution timeline of 36 months.
